entities.name: Cheikh Mwijo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cheikh Mwijo, born Moshe Attias in Meknes in 1937 and died on 2 May 2020 in Kiryat Ata, was a Moroccan musician and songwriter. He was one of the icons of Moroccan Jewish music.
